sla_threshold_note: A manual wire-review case meets the time-to-clear SLA if it was cleared within 480 minutes (1 business day of wire cut-off).
calculation_description: Share of all cleared wire-review cases in the period (every category, weighted equally) that met the 480-minute threshold. This is the standard reported methodology.

method_descriptions.all_cases_within_sla: Every cleared wire-review case counts equally toward the 480-minute threshold. Current standard methodology.
method_descriptions.exclude_reopened: Omits cases that were reopened after an initial clear decision.
method_descriptions.exclude_escalated: Counts only standard-path cases; cases escalated to a second-level reviewer are omitted from the denominator.
method_descriptions.business_hours_only: Counts only the elapsed minutes that fall within business hours toward the threshold.
method_descriptions.median_ttd: Reports the median time-to-clear against the threshold rather than the share of cases meeting it.

team_incentive: The quarterly ops-scorecard bonus pool is released if attainment is at or above the 93% target at period close.
methodology_change_policy: The reported calculation_method is governed by Ops Handbook Section 6.2. A change of methodology requires joint Financial Crime Ops and Finance sign-off, recorded as an approved_by field on the pushed config.
